title: fix(console): a view added in an app is saved into that app, so its draft preview bar counts and publishes it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYVDXYrivhXfHAcQhpvNFNs)_
Fixes #35624

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUjtFEFN5FLe377MBT

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new published language-pack key, `view.savedOutsideApp`, in all eleven packs (re-declared by the seat, claim amendment 7026282261)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在应用里用「新建视图」或「另存为视图」建的视图，现在直接存进这个应用（只读应用存进它的定制包）；预览条马上显示「1 项未发布更改」并能一键发布，之前它会说「没有未发布的更改」。
- 落实您对「新建视图存到哪里」的裁决「存进应用定制包」，替在应用控制台里建视图的作者解决预览条漏计、发布后新视图不上线的问题。
- 万一判断有误，最坏情况是新视图像以前一样存成不属于任何包的草稿，并多弹一条提示让作者去首页发布；不会丢数据，可直接撤回本改动。
- 无

Branch note for the Duplicate Fix Guard: this is the harness's branch `claude/project-thread-g62vj4`; the repo's `claude/issue-35624-*` spelling was not available in this card thread.

## What changes

Measured on examples/app-crm before this PR (card comment 7023978062): Add new view sent `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/crm_account.NAME?mode=draft` naming no package. The app's draft preview bar counts only the app's package and its customization pair (`appDraftPackages`), so it read "no unpublished changes" over the pending draft every time, and its Publish left the new view a draft.

Per ruling C (comment 7024102451, 「C 存进应用定制包」):

1. **Destination resolver** (`resolveRuntimeCreatePackage` in `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`): given the routed app's package (`draftBarPackageOf`, the bar's own rule), the create saves into the app's own package when the package list says it is writable, else into its customization package, which the ensure door answers (`POST /api/v1/packages/BASE/ensure-customization`, ADR-0146 D3, created on first use). `createRuntimeMetadata` sends that as `?package=`. The two create callers (`useObjectViewViewCrud`'s `handleViewCreate`, `ObjectDataPage`'s Save as view) pass the app through one hook, `useRuntimeCreateApp`. Any create that goes through `handleViewCreate` is covered, including a new create path that calls it.
2. **Same address afterwards**: edit, read, discard and publish keep naming no package. Measured live, the `/meta` doors address a name's one holding package when the request names none (ADR-0146 D8): a package-less save, draft read, discard and publish of a pair-held view each answered for `package=com.example.crm.custom`, and `_drafts` kept one row. A view saved package-less before this PR keeps its package-less address; naming the app's pair there would fork it. This follows the rule objectui#12335 set for a caller that does not know the binding.
3. **Fallback**: when the package list does not list the app, or the ensure door refuses (a walled deployment answers a tenant administrator 403), the create saves naming no package, as before, and an info toast says that this app's draft bar does not count or publish the view and that it is published from Home. This is one new language-pack key, `view.savedOutsideApp`, in all eleven packs. It widens the published key set, so the seat re-declares Clause-② (see Acceptance notes).
4. Report, dashboard and page creates are untouched: only `type === 'view'` reads the app.

The #35620 Studio note was re-read and left alone. A view saved into the pair takes its 'none' arm, "{package} does not ship this view, so it is not customized here.", and that sentence is still true. The 'environment' arm still describes package-less views made before this PR. This was checked by reading the code only; it was not driven in the browser.

## Tests

New pins, one file per design step, all under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/`:

- `runtime-metadata-persistence.createIntoApp-35624.test.ts` (step 1): a real `MetadataClient`. For a read-only base it sends `GET /api/v1/packages`, then the ensure POST, then `PUT ...?mode=draft&package=com.example.crm.custom`. For a writable app it sends its own id and asks for no pair. Outside an app nothing changes.
- `runtime-metadata-persistence.sameAddress-35624.test.ts` (step 2): edit, read, discard and publish send no `?package=` and ask no package door.
- `runtime-metadata-persistence.walledFallback-35624.test.tsx` (step 3): after an ensure 403 (in the router's error envelope) or an unlisted app, the create saves package-less and the notice runs once, after the save. `useRuntimeCreateApp` resolves the routed app and shows the info toast.
- `runtime-metadata-persistence.otherTypesUntouched-35624.test.ts` (step 4): report, dashboard and page save `{ mode: 'draft' }` and ask nothing.

Existing pins moved: `ObjectDataPage.saveAsViewRefusal-11578`, `CreateViewDialog.chartBinding-11576` and `CreateViewDialog.viewTypeParse-11581` route under `/apps/demo`, so they now answer the package list (`demo` writable). Two of them gained the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` prescribes, because the hook's import of the draft bar reaches `usePublishAllDrafts`.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- New pins: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 10 passed (10).
- Touched surface plus every test file importing the changed modules (235 files), `app-shell/src/preview/` and `i18n/`: Test Files 387 passed, 1 failed (388). The one red was `zh-hant-generated` (the zh-Hant pack is generated). It was regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`, and `packages/i18n/` then gave Test Files 104 passed (104).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: VERDICT command-exit 0, after rebuilding a stale `@object-ui/plugin-grid` dist. `tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all 4 new files.
- Ablation, run once on the committed fix with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The resolver's first branch was replaced with `return null;` (anchor x1 to x0, blob 5a4f2ab7 to 40c6f3ca). The createIntoApp file then gave 2 failed, 1 passed: the read-only and writable cases went red, and the outside-app control stayed green. The restore brought the blob back to 5a4f2ab7, equal to HEAD, with `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports source, so no dist was involved.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② deviation**: the claim line `Clause-②: no` is copied as given, but `view.savedOutsideApp` is a new key in the published `@object-ui/i18n` packs. That is a widening, so the seat re-declares it.
- The walled 403 was not booted. In the browser rig the ensure door was refused at the network (`page.route`) with a 403 in the router's measured error envelope. The real door's code path is `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`.
- Inside preview mode, the bar counts a new pair draft about 0.4 s after the PUT, on its own re-read after the pulse (`c-settle.log`). This settles by itself and needs no change.
- Package-less views created before this PR stay package-less and uncounted by the app bar, as ruled. There is no migration.
- The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (1722 files with preview and i18n) was not run locally. It is left to CI's Test UI. Locally only the files importing the changed modules ran.

## Verification

Two-minute check: on examples/app-crm (`objectstack dev --seed-admin` plus the console with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`), open Accounts, choose Add new view, and create a Grid view. Expected: the bar reads "Draft preview · 1 unpublished change in this app" with Publish, and the network shows `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/crm_account.NAME?mode=draft&package=com.example.crm.custom`.

Files to read first, by risk:

1. `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`: `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage` and the `createRuntimeMetadata` hunk (destination and fallback).
2. `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`: `useRuntimeCreateApp` (the app rule and the toast).
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`: `view.savedOutsideApp` (the new sentence).

<details><summary>Browser journey on the fixed console (screenshots in the seat's build folder, prefix c-)</summary>

- S1 Add new view `c_edit`: ensure POST 200 (the pair was created 201 by the first create of the run), then `PUT ...?mode=draft&package=com.example.crm.custom` 200. At 1.19 s the bar read "2 unpublished changes in this app" with Publish, and `_drafts` listed both pair drafts. The bar read the same at 3.63 s.
- S2 edit through Manage views, Edit view config, Save: `PUT ...c_edit?mode=draft` 200, naming no package. `_drafts` still had one `c_edit` row, in the pair, and the draft read gave label "C edit (edited)" with `_packageId` `com.example.crm.custom`.
- S3 RuntimeDraftBar Discard: `DELETE ...c_edit?state=draft` 200. The bar went from 2 to 1, and `c_edit` left `_drafts`.
- S4 single-item Publish of a new `c_single`: `POST .../crm_account.c_single/publish` 200. The draft left `_drafts`, and the published read is held by `com.example.crm.custom`.
- S5 bar Publish of a new `c_bar`: `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.crm.custom/publish-drafts` 200. Preview exited onto the new view's URL with "C bar" live, and `_drafts` was empty.
- S6 ensure refused 403: `PUT ...c_walled?mode=draft` 200, naming no package. The toast read "This view was saved as a draft outside this app, ... publish it from Home.", the bar read "no unpublished changes", and `_drafts` listed `crm_account.c_walled@null`.

</details>
